claim_ceiling: ADR-0344 Proposed/advisory manifest declaration only; no runtime instrumentation or governance lane runtime changes, measured emissions, live billing, OpenCost/FOCUS export, generated JSON, or production FinOps readiness claim.

workload_signal_source.source_ref: policy lane execution, evidence emission, check-crate invocation, finding query, and promotion-event workflows

power_model.derivation_note: Values reflect medium CPU check-lane work, governance evidence storage, and higher outbound policy/evidence lookups; signal remains per_workflow_run rather than per_request.

price_model.non_claim: Fixture binds governance workflow SKU attribution only and does not charge tenants or mutate release governance evidence.

review_notes.no_carbon_deferral: Tier 1 policy/evidence gates cannot be deferred when they guard release, compliance, or security decisions.
review_notes.security_tenant_data_plane: Governance touches tenant-scoped evidence, policy decisions, and promotion state rather than customer-authored code.
review_notes.audit_chain: Lane-execute and audit-refresh rows are the future attribution source for governance workflow emissions.

failure_cases: lane-execute row missing one ADR-0344 field
evidence-emitter storage left out of baseline
governance gate delayed by carbon-aware scheduling

recalibration.evidence_floor: samples for policy gate validation, evidence emission, and conformance-query workflows
